summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K (overseas regulatory announcement equivalent to a US current report) giving notice that a committee of its Board will meet on 27 October 2026 to consider its Q3 2026 earnings release and a third interim dividend for 2026. Subject to approval, the dividend is payable 17 December 2026 to holders of record 6 November 2026 across the UK, Hong Kong, Bermuda registers and New York ADS holders. No special-situation transaction, terms, advisor or board recommendation is present; this is a routine meeting notice.
